title: Split Second
logline: Rin is carrying the cure for 40,000 people. The Hound wants it buried. Every choice is a split second. Choose wrong and you flatline.

cast.rin: Rin, 19, street courier with a chrome left arm. Fast, cocky, out of options.
cast.hound: The Hound, a faceless corporate cyber-assassin. Hunts with drones and a red mono-wire blade.
cast.dex: Dex, Rin's fixer. Talks her through the run on her earpiece and waits with the van.

rule: Each decision scene shows a clue for the safe route. Wrong pick or no pick in 5 seconds: the Hound catches her, then GAME OVER and try again.

decisions.name: The Edge
decisions.clue: red hunter drones are sweeping the rooftop vents

decisions.name: The Market
decisions.clue: the alley is empty except for a red drone hovering over it

decisions.name: The Platform
decisions.clue: the carriage is dark and empty, lit only by red emergency light

decisions.name: The Drop
decisions.clue: Dex is waving her down from the van, and up ahead the highway curves away from the tracks

scenes.prompt: Camera locked off: the title key art comes alive, rain, flickering neon, Rin and the Hound hold their leap, the SPLIT SECOND letters stay sharp with a soft cyan pulse. (H3 Max, pinned at both ends to the redrawn key art.)

Close-up, camera locked off: Rin holds the chip steady in her chrome palm, the DNA hologram turns. Dex's line (kept from the audited take) plays off screen. (H3 Max, pinned at both ends to one sheet-drawn frame.)
captions: That chip is the cure. Forty thousand people in the Lower City are running out of time.
The corp that made them sick wants it gone. So they sent the Hound.

scenes.prompt: Rin stays crouched on the rooftop edge, answers her earpiece and closes her hand on the chip. Dex's call is kept from the audited take. Nobody speaks on screen.
captions: Get it to Dex at the rail yard. And don't get caught.

scenes.prompt: Rin runs across the roof toward the camera, glancing back; on the far roof the Hound lands and rises. Hard cut to her at the edge.
Camera locked off. Rin holds at the edge, back to camera; drones sweep the vent; the billboard shows a wordless can ad.
captions: Tap where Rin runs. Wait too long and she's caught.

scenes.prompt: Rin leaps to the fixed ladder and slides down it. Hard cut to the market fork.
Rin dives for the vent. Hard cut: she crawls out of a grate on the back street; the Hound steps out of the dark and hauls her up by the collar.
Rin, back to camera, at the fork: the umbrella crowd left, the dark alley right with a red drone.
Camera locked off. Rin runs left into the walking umbrella crowd until only her hair shows.
Rin runs deep into the alley under the red drone. Hard cut inside the alley: the Hound drops from the fire escape beside her and grabs her shoulder.
Camera locked off. Rin holds on the platform, back to camera; the red emergency light pulses in the open door.
Rin climbs the fixed ladder. Hard cut to the train roof: the van pulls in right beside her, rear doors open, Dex waving from the driver's window.
Rin steps into the red-lit door. Hard cut inside the carriage: she sprints down the aisle and the Hound lunges from the seats and yanks her back by her chrome arm.
Camera rides along: train and van race side by side, the van right beside her with doors open, Dex waving.
captions: Tap the van before it's gone.

scenes.prompt: A short hop into the open cargo bay. The doors shut and the van pulls ahead up the exit ramp and away for good.
No tap: the doors shut and the van takes the exit without her. The Hound walks up the train roof behind her and lays a hand on her shoulder.
Through the windshield: Dex drives and smirks, Rin laughs and lifts the chip. Nobody speaks.
The Hound alone on the train roof, back to camera, watches the van climb the ramp and disappear. His blade dims.
The victory card comes alive: neon flickers, rain falls, Rin flips the glowing chip and catches it, Dex chuckles, the DELIVERED letters pulse bright cyan. Triumphant synth chord.

The game over card glitches violently: red digital noise tears across the frame, the Hound's red visor pulses, the FLATLINED letters stutter and distort. A flatline heart monitor tone, a deep distorted bass hit, static.

replay: TRY AGAIN restarts at the Hound's arrival, so the title, the stakes and Dex's call play only on a fresh start.
method: See BIBLE.md and RUBRIC.md. Every keyframe is drawn from the character sheets and a location plate; every take is pinned at both ends and stays in one place; two places are two takes joined by a hard cut; dialogue in captions; every clip graded by two graders before review.
